challenge.reason: Offline same-provider calibration judgement only. Gitignore prevents ordinary commits but does not prevent plaintext secrets being written to disk, read by other processes, retained after a session, or included in backups. The old env-only decision forbids this persistence. Small process.env access savings do not justify removing that protection; in-memory caching would address repeated lookup without a credentials file. The claimed absence of behaviour change is false.
